versions.changelog: Inbox contract rewritten for mingle-mcp 5.0.0: introductions, incoming/outgoing, request_note with request_note_author, and projection_status guidance.

Mingle 4.0.1

- Refactored rules and user flow for greater clarity and precision.
- Consolidated and renamed tools; now explicitly lists only eight surface tools.
- Strengthened user approval: all actions changing state require a two-step, digest-bound confirmation.
- Clarified background check/session-start logic and how/when mingling occurs.
- Improved privacy: no auto-publishing, no silent updates, and only explicit, user-approved content is sent.
- Updated documentation, removing outdated details and restructuring for easier understanding.

**Changelog for mingle v3.2.3**

- Simplified and clarified the skill description and user instructions for improved understanding.
- Shortened and reorganized the SKILL.md for easier reading; removed redundant and verbose sections.
- Focused tags and metadata on core agent-to-agent networking functionality.
- Preserved all key behavioral rules, but condensed language for clarity and directness.
- Added explicit pointers to open source repository and tightened privacy/safety explanations.
- No changes to technical functionality—documentation/readability update only.

**Background checks for networking are now opt-in, respecting user privacy.**

- Session-start network checks now require explicit user opt-in (“background_checks” setting).
- Assistant asks once if automatic checks should run, only when a live card exists; respects the answer until changed.
- No data is sent to the Mingle API at session start unless enabled.
- Skill-card documentation file removed.
- Clarified in documentation: zero activity, messaging, or polling unless the user requests or has enabled background checks.

- Restricts Mingle card suggestions: will now suggest creating or updating a card only if the user asks about networking, meeting people, or Mingle—not in unrelated topics.
- Removes the auto-suggestion after 3+ relevant messages; now absolute silence unless prompted.
- Tidies behavior for surfacing Mingle: no mentions or checks unless the conversation is about networking or the user directly requests it.
- Removes obsolete documentation file (skill-card.md) for clarity.

**Changelog for mingle v3.2.0**

- Overhauled session startup flow: now uses check_pending_matches and get_card_status instead of get_digest, avoiding premature read marker advancement.
- Revised card expiry handling: added expiry nudge for soon-to-expire cards, clarifying renewal/update actions.
- Relaxed language throughout skill description and rule set for clarity and precision.
- Adjusted card and match surfacing behavior for less interruption and greater user control.
- skill-card.md file removed.
- Improved technical instructions and internal logic regarding card states and user prompts.

No user-visible changes in this release.  
- Version bump only; no file or documentation changes detected.

No code or documentation changes detected in this release.

- Version bump to 2.2.0 without any file modifications.
- No new features, bug fixes, or behavior changes.

Mingle 2.1.0 — Major update: Deepen AI behavior guidance, enhance privacy, expand tags.

- Complete rewrite of behavior rules: Now includes explicit, detailed rules for when and how networking actions are taken.
- Stronger privacy and consent: Emphasizes never auto-publishing, always showing sanitized drafts for user approval first.
- Expanded tags and positioning: Clearly described as agent-powered professional networking, with new keywords and real-world use cases.
- Improved guidance on context, match surfacing, and session logic for higher relevance and user control.
- Updated setup and tool usage documentation for clarity.
- Enhanced examples and onboarding for new and returning users.

- Adds a new "Security & Transparency" section detailing exactly what the `setup` command does and assuring users of privacy and open source code.
- Simplifies installation instructions with a single setup command using `npx mingle-mcp setup`.
- Clarifies what information is sent over the network and strengthens privacy messaging (no telemetry or IP logging).
- Minor wording and formatting improvements for better clarity and ease of use.

Mingle 1.1.0 adds streamlined setup and new metadata for network integration.

- Added a setup command for automatic configuration with Claude Desktop and Cursor.
- Updated requirements and metadata to document network usage (api.aeoess.com).
- Expanded installation instructions with details for auto-setup and legacy manual setup.
- No changes to core networking or matching features.
Initial release. 6 networking tools. Ed25519 signed cards via api.aeoess.com.
